title: No Means Not Now
primary_theme: Fund-of-funds exposure to venture innovation and private market evolution
founder_lessons: Understand venture as a long-duration way to invest at the front end of innovation.
Use fund-of-funds diversification when the goal is broad venture exposure rather than single-company risk.
Expect private companies to stay private longer and plan liquidity around secondary and gray-market evolution.
Recognize that technology hubs are global, but local advantage still shapes access and selection.
notable_quotes: I try to describe a portfolio of funds as a mutual fund of venture capital funds.
Most of it's really around grants, but it's been fun to be involved with and watching the enthusiasm and success of entrepreneurs in those small towns
